Name: Winter Extras
Author: BossMK
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/cSyrUaQ.png[/img]﻿

This is a mod made for the winter contest in the stardew valley discord, it adds 6 items to stardew valley, 4 of which are craftable from the kitchen:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ifI3Ei8.png[/img]﻿

For now, recipes are automatically unlocked when you get the kitchen house upgrade, and the two uncraftable items (Caramel Cubes and the Chocobar) are obtainable at the Saloon. I hope you enjoy it!

Note: This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
